question: 给无线耳机 LUMO 做一条广告，面向通勤的年轻上班族，核心是“一戴上，世界就安静了”。
ground_truth: The agent checks the three services answer and no other run is active, runs `node dist/cli.js ad` with the brief verbatim in single quotes in the background, leaving --duration (30 s master), --ratio (16:9), --resolution and --fps at their defaults because the brief states none, reports progress from the stage lines, and when it finishes reports the film path, per-shot gate results, the measured total and open items from reports/delivery.md.

question: 先给我看脚本和分镜，我确认了再生成视频。
ground_truth: The agent runs `node dist/cli.js ad` with --plan-only, shows creative/treatment.json, script/script.json (English vo, Chinese zh and titles per beat) and storyboard/storyboard.json, and only after the user approves runs the full pipeline.

question: 再帮我同时做一支咖啡的广告。
ground_truth: The agent sees a run is already active, explains that one film runs at a time on the single GPU, and queues the second brief to start when the first finishes instead of launching it in parallel.
